title: ACwO Twister 717 | Hybrid ANC up to 38dB | X- Fidelity Acoustics | Bass BooMX™ 40mm Drivers | Dual EQ Modes: Gaming & Cinematic | Up to 55 Hours Music Playtime (ANC Off) - Cool Grey
bullets: ✅ Hybrid ANC up to 38dB – Silence Redefined: Block out distractions with advanced feedback & feedforward mic module for immersive noise cancellation anytime, anywhere.
✅ X-Fidelity Acoustics – Hear Every Detail: Experience studio-grade sound clarity with balanced highs, mids, and thumping bass for pure audio bliss.
✅ Bass BooMX 40mm Drivers – Feel the Boom: Custom-tuned drivers deliver rich, deep bass and vibrant highs that elevate every beat and drop.
✅ Dual EQ Modes – Game or Chill, You Choose: Switch seamlessly between Gaming Mode for ultra-clear action and Cinematic Mode for theater-like immersion.
✅ Ultra-Low 45ms Latency – Lag-Free Audio Sync: Game, stream, or call with near-zero delay for real-time sound that keeps you in the zone.
